node_input.allowed_content: full file because README establishes it as non-response patch ID/area/centroid geometry

evidence.primary_study: Fountain et al. 2018, Inferring dispersal across a fragmented landscape using reconstructed families in the Glanville fritillary butterfly
evidence.interpretation: independent reconstructed-family/genetic dispersal evidence; 1 km is used as a mean-dispersal reference scale, not a hard maximum dispersal limit

analyst_choice_structural_axis.construction: minimum Euclidean patch-centroid distance threshold reaching each target largest weak component fraction, with tied distances admitted together
analyst_choice_structural_axis.interpretation: local/intermediate/regional/near-spanning response-blind structural bracket; not biological dispersal distances

world_universe_at_gate1.reason_for_deferral: first establish that the primary spatial world family brackets the regional patch-network scale before adding restrictive secondary axes

forecast_structure.future_source_policy: all realized occupied patches at year t become declared current sources for forecasting t+1; exact response years remain unopened until later gates
forecast_structure.historical_claim: none; this is conditional annual metapopulation propagation, not ancestry reconstruction

structural_adequacy_declaration.applies_to: primary analyst-choice structural worlds as a family, not the biologically calibrated 1 km reference world individually
requirements: the declared 0.90 structural level must achieve largest weak component fraction >= 0.90 by construction
the 0.90 structural level must have isolated-node fraction <= 0.05
at least three distinct positive distance thresholds must be present across the four structural levels
thresholds and edge sets must be nested and deterministic under the frozen node geometry
structural_adequacy_declaration.horizon_reachability: report one-step reachability distributions but do not impose a universal minimum because annual colonization is local and the later source set contains all current occupied patches
structural_adequacy_declaration.stop_rule: if these response-blind structural requirements fail, stop before reading survey_data.tsv response fields

next_if_pass: freeze exact patch-network schema and structural thresholds/fingerprints
read only response-free year/patch fields needed to freeze temporal split
freeze annual forecast source/update rule and external metapopulation comparator
only then open population response once
no_retuning: Do not change 1 km reference, LCC targets, isolated-node criterion, annual horizon, or source-policy class after occupancy response access.
